title: 第五章 安家和君悦府第六章 徐文昌的震惊
content_zh:
“不错，你只需要告诉我一个最低价，合适我就买。”姜辰点点头。
“姜先生，宾利慕尚六百万，劳斯莱斯魅影五百万，奥迪S6八十万。这是我能够给的最低价。”陈茜茜说道。
“可以。”姜辰对聂星辰说道：“聂秘书，去你处理一下，全部挂在公司。”
“好的。”聂星辰看向了陈茜茜。
这就同意了？
陈茜茜还以为姜辰会讨价还价一段时间，没想到就这么的同意了。
这是买车，买豪车啊！不是在买菜啊。
这一刻，陈茜茜被打击的体无完肤。
“陈主管？”聂星辰看着陈茜茜。
“请，请跟我来。”陈茜茜深吸一口气，连忙说道。
姜辰看着陈茜茜的背影，在心中默念道：“系统，签到！”
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得技能：高级车技。】
“高级车技？”
一股知识涌现在了姜辰脑海中。
等消化了这股知识之后，姜辰才知道什么叫住高级车技。
“是因为买车才签到车技么？”
姜辰若有所思。
半个小时后，相关手续全部办好了。
姜辰让陈茜茜派人明天将宾利慕尚和奥迪送去公司，自己开着劳斯莱斯和聂星辰离开了。
“姜辰，我们这不是去公司吗？”聂星辰问道。

“对，我准备买房子，你帮我去看看。我呢，今天就放你半天的假。”姜辰说道。
“之前姜总转的那笔钱是为了买房吗？”聂星辰问道。
“是的。”姜辰
“姜总准备买什么样的房子？”聂星辰问道。
“我现在一个月的工资是十万。手中才不到两亿，所以，像九章别墅，汤臣一品等地方是买不起的。现在只能退而求其次了。”姜辰回答道。
“……”聂星辰。
聂星辰不知道说什么才好。
这一刻，她终于知道什么是装十三了。
这就是装十三。
“姜总，想要买房的话，就必须找一家房产中介。”聂星辰说道。
“你有认识的吗？”姜辰问道。
“没有。”聂星辰摇摇头。
“那就随便找一家吧。？”姜辰目光看向了远处，说道：“你看，那边就有一家中介公司，我们过去看看？”
content_en:
"Yes, you just need to tell me the lowest price. If it suits me, I will buy it." Jiang Chen nodded.
"Mr. Jiang, the Bentley Mulsanne is 6 million, the Rolls-Royce Phantom is 5 million, and the Audi S6 is 800,000. This is the lowest price I can give." Chen Qianqian said.
"Okay." Jiang Chen said to Nie Xingchen: "Secretary Nie, go handle it and leave it all in the company."
"Okay." Nie Xingchen looked at Chen Qianqian.
Do you agree?
Chen Qianqian thought Jiang Chen would bargain for a while, but she didn't expect to agree so much.
This is buying a car, buying a luxury car! I'm not buying groceries.
At this moment, Chen Qianqian was severely hit.
"Director Chen?" Nie Xingchen looked at Chen Qianqian.
"Please, please come with me." Chen Qianqian took a deep breath and said quickly.
Jiang Chen looked at Chen Qianqian's back and said silently in his heart: "System, sign in!"
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and obtained the skill: advanced driving skills. 】
"Advanced driving skills?"
A stream of knowledge emerged in Jiang Chen's mind.
After digesting this knowledge, Jiang Chen knew what advanced driving skills meant.
"Did you sign up for the driving skills because you wanted to buy a car?"
Jiang Chen was thoughtful.
Half an hour later, all relevant procedures were completed.
Jiang Chen asked Chen Qianqian to send someone to send the Bentley Mulsanne and Audi to the company tomorrow, and he left in a Rolls-Royce and Nie Xingchen.
"Jiang Chen, aren't we going to the company?" Nie Xingchen asked.
"Yes, I'm going to buy a house. Please help me check it out. As for me, I'll give you half a day off today," Jiang Chen said.
"Was the money that Mr. Jiang transferred before to buy a house?" Nie Xingchen asked.
"Yes." Jiang Chen
"What kind of house is Mr. Jiang going to buy?" Nie Xingchen asked.
"My current monthly salary is 100,000 yuan. I only have less than 200 million yuan in hand, so I can't afford places like Jiuzhang Villa, Tomson Yipin, etc. Now I can only settle for the next best thing." Jiang Chen replied.
"..." Nie Xingchen.
Nie Xingchen didn't know what to say.
At this moment, she finally knew what pretending to be thirteen meant.
This is pretending to be thirteen.
"Mr. Jiang, if you want to buy a house, you must find a real estate agency." Nie Xingchen said.
"Do you know anyone?" Jiang Chen asked.
"No." Nie Xingchen shook his head.
"Then let's just find one." Jiang Chen looked into the distance and said, "Look, there is an agency over there. Let's go and have a look?"
